title: How to Cancel 1Password — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel 1Password subscription. Export your passwords first, then stop the $2.99/mo charge. Keep access to your vault data.
intro: Before canceling 1Password, export your passwords — after cancellation your vault becomes read-only (you can view but not add new entries). The free period allows you to export everything.

steps.title: Export your passwords first
steps.text: Open 1Password → File → Export → select your vault → export as .1pux or .csv. Save this file securely — you'll need it to import into another password manager.
steps.tip: Export BEFORE canceling. After cancellation, your vault is read-only but export may still work for a limited time.

steps.title: Go to 1Password billing settings
steps.text: Visit my.1password.com/settings/billing while signed in to your 1Password account.

steps.title: Click "Cancel subscription" or "Manage billing"
steps.text: Find the cancellation option in your billing settings and click it. 1Password will explain what happens to your data.

steps.title: Confirm cancellation
steps.text: Confirm your choice. Your vault data remains accessible in read-only mode (view passwords, but can't add new ones). Paid features are disabled.
steps.tip: After cancellation, your vault stays intact. If you re-subscribe later, everything is restored.

warnings: Your vault becomes read-only after cancellation — you can view existing passwords but not create or edit entries.
If subscribed through Apple, cancel through iOS Settings → Subscriptions.
Family plan: all members lose premium features if the organizer cancels.
Export your data before canceling to ensure you have a backup.

faqs.q: Will I lose my passwords if I cancel 1Password?
faqs.a: No. Your vault remains in read-only mode — you can view and copy passwords. You just can't add new entries. Export your data as a backup regardless.
Bitwarden (free tier, open source, cross-platform), Apple Keychain (free, Apple ecosystem), and KeePassXC (free, local-only) are excellent alternatives.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund from 1Password?
faqs.a: 1Password may offer refunds within a short window of purchase. Contact support@1password.com for requests.

faqs.q: How do I transfer to Bitwarden?
faqs.a: Export from 1Password as .1pux or .csv → Import into Bitwarden (Settings → Import Data → select 1Password format → upload file). Takes 5 minutes.

refund.details: 1Password may refund recent charges. Contact support@1password.com. Apple subscriptions must be refunded through Apple.

retentionTactics: 1Password doesn't use aggressive retention tactics. Cancellation is straightforward.
